paite: Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen ahi, ka zuau kei, Kha Siangthou ah ka sia-le-pha theihna in leng hon theihpih hi.
heading: Paul Leh Judate
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

paite: Ka lungtang ah haksatna thupitak leh lungngaihna dai thei lou ka pai hi.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

paite: Ka unaute salam a ka chipihte sik in, kei pen Khrist a kipan hihtuam khop hial in hamsethuak in om leng ka chi hi.
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

paite: Amau Israel mi ahi ngal ua; ta hihna, thupina leh thukhun tengteng, dan piakna leh Pathian nasepna a thuchiam tengteng amau a ahi.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

paite: Pipute leng amau a ahi ua, salam thu ah Khrist leng amau a kipan a hong pawt ahi a; amah thil tengteng tung a om, tangtawn a phat tuak Pathian ahi. Amen.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

paite: Himahleh Pathian thu bangmah lou bang a omta ahi kei hi. Israel suante Israel mi ahi vek kei uh;
heading: Pathian Athuchiam A Muanhuai
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

paite: Abraham suante ahih ziak un avek un atate leng ahi kei uhi, "Isak ah na suante akiminloh ding," chih ahi zaw hi.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

paite: Huai sa tate Pathian tate chihna ahi kei ua, thuchiam tate Abraham suan a seh ahi uh chihna ahi zaw uhi.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

paite: Thuchiam pen hiai ahi, "Tu hun bang in ka hong dia, Sarah in tapa anei ding,"
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

paite: Huai phet ahi kei Rebekah in leng i pu Isak lak a nau apai lai in,
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

paite: naupangte apian ma uh, sia-le-pha atheih ma un, thilhih ziak hilou in, asampa deihna ziak zaw in, tel lam thu ah Pathian thiltup akiptheihna ding in akiang ah;
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

paite: "A-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding," Pathian in achi hi.
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

paite: "Jakob ka it a, Esau zaw ka hua," chih gelh bang in.
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

paite: Bang i genta ding ua le? Pathian ah diktatlouhna a-om a hia?
heading: Pathian Thuneihna Kim Neitu
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

paite: Om lou hial! Ama'n, "Ka hehpih peuhmah ka hehpih dia, zah ka ngaihna tung peuhmah ah zah ka ngai ding," chi in Mosi kiang ah agenta hi.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

paite: Huaiziak in adeihpa ziak ahi kei a, ataipa ziak leng ahi sam kei a, ahehpihpa Pathian ziak ahi zaw hi.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

paite: Laisiangthou in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai ziak tak in ahi ka hon tunding, nang a ka thilhihtheihna ka taklat theihna ding leh leitung tengteng a ka min athantheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in zahngaihna asuah ut peuhmah tung ah azahngai a, a-ut peuhmah alungkhauhsak hi.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

paite: Nou ka kiang ah, bangziak a ama'n moh a hon dem lai ahia? Kua in adeihlam kalh ahia? hon chi ding na hih tuak uhi.
heading: Pathian Bang Teng Tung A Thunei
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

paite: Ahi a, mihing aw, nang Pathian nial vialpa kua na hia le? Thilsiam in asiampa kiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a hon siam,” achi dia hia?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

paite: Tungman tang khat a pan bel khat kilawmtak, manphatak a zat ding leh manpha lou deuh a zat ding bawl ding in belvelpa'n tungman tung ah thu anei kei a hia?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

paite: Pathian in ahehna leh athilhihtheihna latsak a-ut a, ahehna thuak ding a hihsiat a om ding a abawlkholhte tung a ahehpihna hauhdan alatsak a athuakzoh teiteileh bang apoi a?
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

paite: Huchi a athupina hauhsaknate, azahngaihna thupina tang ding a abawlkholhte tung a asunbuakleh alatsak theihna ding in,
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

paite: huaite tuh eite i hi ua, Judate lak a kipan kia hilou in, Zentelte lak a kipan a leng sapte ahi.
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

paite: Hosea laibu ah: "Ka mite hi ngei lou, ka mite, ka chi dia; it ngei louhnu leng itnu, ka chita ding hi.
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, akiang ua, ka mite na hi kei uh achihna mun ngei ah Pathian hing tate chih in a- omta ding uh, chih gelh bang in."
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

paite: Isai in leng Israel mite thu kikoupih in, "Israel mite zaw tuipi piaunel zah in tam mah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia hotdam in a-om ding uh.
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

paite: Toupa'n kintak a hihzou vek in leitung ah agawt ding thu atangtun dek ngal a," achi hi.
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

paite: Isai in, "Sepaihte' Toupa'n chisuah ding hon na hawisak lou hileh Sodom khua bang in i na omta ding ua, Gomorrah khua bang a bawl in i na omta ding uh," chi a agenkholh bang in.
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

paite: Bang i genta dia le? Zentel, diktatna delhloute'n, ginna ziak adiktatna tuh ana phata uhi.
heading: Tu Hun A Israel Dinmun
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

paite: Israel, diktatna dan delhte'n, diktatna pen aphazouta kei uh.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

paite: Bangziak in ahia? Ginna in adelh kei ua, thilhih a muh theih bang a adelh ziak uh ahi. Pukna suang ah apukta uhi.
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

paite: Laisiangthou in: "Ngai in, Zion ah kisuihna suang leh pukna suangpi ka koih a, kuapeuh amah gingta tuh azahlak kei ding," chih gelh bang in.
english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
